name: velociraptor
notes: Velociraptor: a small raptor the size of a big turkey, 2 m long and half a metre at the hips, slim and long-legged, with a long low snout, feathered arms and tail fan and the sickle claw on each foot. Sandy buff spotted with brown, the wing feathers dark with pale tips. Hunts small animals in twos and threes.
